# Action items across the vault

**Generated, not authored. Do not edit this file.** Every item's state lives in its own knowledge base, in `<KB>/Wiki/questions.md` under *Action items*. This is a read-only roll-up of the ones still needing you, written by `_scripts/actionitems.py` at the end of every run that touches an item.

Editing here would create a second place recording the same state, and the two would drift. Change an item where it lives; this file catches up on the next run.
